evidence.excerpt: We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench.
